name: Notible Habits
description: Track habits in the sidebar: tick off what is due today, keep a streak, and see a year at a glance. Daily, on chosen weekdays, every few days or a weekly target.
author: Notible
guide:
Open **Habits** in the sidebar and click **New habit**: give it a name and choose how often. Tick it off on the days you do it.

Open a habit to see its streak and a heatmap of the year. Habits are ordinary items: they sync, search and export like everything else.
